comment: Read from the maker's source at commit 157a217, the head of main, which is one of three commits carrying the installed 2.1.0 (291430e bumped the version, a1c2bdd and 157a217 touched only README, CI and the changelog); src/ and res/ are byte-identical across all three, so there is nothing to settle between them. The installed build is confirmed by the delimiter wording 'Reload CSV from disk', 'Detect automatically (' and 'Custom character, then Enter:', which arrived in d3bba0e just before the bump. Index order matches panel order here, left to right: inputs TRIG and RESET, then knobs RANGE and LENGTH on the same row, then the five outputs END, -5-5V, 0-10V, V/OCT and GATE on the row below. Panel names were read from a render of res/LoudNumbers.svg and are shorter than the maker's configured names: the panel prints RANGE for 'Octave range', LENGTH for 'Gate length', TRIG for 'Trigger', END for 'End of Data Trigger'. The brief expected this module to do nothing until a file is loaded; it does not — the constructor builds a Dataset from a 64-value defaultdata vector named 'Temps 1956-2019', so a fresh module plays out of the box. It does go silent in the two error states, where process() returns immediately while badcsv is set. The RANGE knob carries a custom ParamQuantity that prints the exact voltage span in its tooltip, for example '6 octaves (-2V to +4V)'. The asymmetric mapping from 4 octaves upward is in voctRange() and is also stated in the README. The chart is a single DataViz widget with no ParamWidget in it, so its hover and click gestures cannot be reached by clicking for help and are written as Note lines. The column list at the foot of the context menu is built from the loaded file rather than being fixed items, so it has no Menu line of its own and is described in the Load CSV note.
